### Template Structure
```
packages/templates/your-template/
├── package.json
├── game.json         (Complete playable game)
├── README.md         (Tutorial and guide)
└── src/
    ├── index.ts
    ├── gameLogic.ts
    ├── playerController.ts
    └── level.ts
```

### Submission Checklist
- [ ] Game is fully playable in editor
- [ ] Includes complete documentation
- [ ] Has example level/content
- [ ] Code is clean and commented
- [ ] README explains how to customize
- [ ] No security issues
- [ ] Follows project conventions
